name: Saldaña (Spain)
description: Quartered green and white above and white and green below, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Saldaña (a saltire on green and red with the words AVE MARIA).
history: Municipal flag of Saldaña; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Saldaña arms — saltire on green and red with the words AVE MARIA
